The clinical presentation strongly supports Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC) as the most likely diagnosis. - MRCP report is unspecified — absence of classic beading/strictures would raise consideration of small-duct PSC or alternative diagnoses  
- Serum IgG4 level not reported — needed to exclude IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis  
- Liver biopsy findings not provided — could help confirm small-duct PSC or assess fibrosis stage, but not required for diagnosis in typical large-duct PSC  
- Colonoscopy/histology details not specified — though known UC is stated, extent and activity may inform PSC risk stratification

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
